data.one_liner: Common widgets and utilities for the FluxStore E-Commerce app
data.what_it_does: Provides a common library of UI components, widgets, and utility extensions used primarily by the FluxStore e-commerce application family.
use_when: You are building a custom app specifically based on FluxStore or requiring its exact utility components.
You need shared e-commerce UI elements and helpers designed by InspireUI.
avoid_when: You are building a general-purpose Flutter application unrelated to FluxStore.
you need modular, decoupled UI components rather than a proprietary app-specific support library.
strengths: Tailored specifically for FluxStore ecosystem requirements.
Includes various built-in extensions and common UI widgets.
weaknesses: Very narrow use case restricted to FluxStore products.
Limited standalone documentation outside of the FluxStore ecosystem.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml; requires Android and iOS configurations consistent with FluxStore plugins.
